subject: Medford High School Stabbing Response
overview: Following a stabbing in a Medford High School bathroom, officials increased police presence while students and parents demanded improved safety protocols. Two individuals were arrested, and the victim was reported to be in stable condition.

items.title: Incident report and police response
items.summary: Police presence was increased at Medford High School after a student was stabbed in a bathroom, leading to two arrests and the victim being hospitalized in stable condition.

items.title: Student safety concerns
items.summary: Students called for further investigation and more security specifically in bathrooms and hallways to address what they described as the primary areas of concern.

items.title: Public reaction and School Committee meeting
items.summary: Parents at a recent School Committee meeting criticized the administration for a lack of safety and called for the return of stricter disciplinary measures like suspensions.
